messages.text: What are you looking for? Happy to help you find the right miner, or answer anything about the gear.
My jingleminer is not displaying bitcoin price

That display pulls the price over the internet, so it's nearly always the wifi connection dropping or an older firmware build. Reboot it, check it's back on your network, and if it's behind on firmware update it first.

Is the unit still showing hashrate and mining, or is the whole screen stuck?
That's the problem I can't because the miner doesn't connect when plugged in to my pc

Nine times out of ten that's the cable: a lot of USB cables are charge-only with no data lines. Swap in a known data cable and try a different port directly on the PC, not a hub.

If it still won't come up, JD and the crew can walk you through it fast on our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post in the server and mention @nullhashrate.

Does the unit power up at all, screen or fans?

Good, so the board's alive. Most of these set up over wifi, not USB: the unit puts out its own network for a few minutes after power-on, you join it from a phone and enter your wifi details there. Worth trying that before the cable route.

I've passed this to JD, who handles the hardware, and he'll come back to you here or by email. Fastest right now is Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post and mention @nullhashrate.

JD's been pinged and will jump in here. Stay in the chat if you can, and if you step away the answer comes to your email.

In the meantime, try the wifi setup route: power the unit, then look for its own network on your phone for a couple of minutes after boot.
Also I can't access the live feed when it's on

That's the same root cause: the live feed and the price both come from the internet, so if the unit never got onto your wifi neither will load. Get it joined to your network and both should come back together.

JD has the details already, so he can pick this up with the full picture. If you want it sorted faster, the Discord link above gets you him and the community right now.
